objects.description: For [C0011](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0011), [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) established SSL certificates on the typo-squatted domains the group registered.(Citation: Cisco Talos Transparent Tribe Education Campaign July 2022)
